critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the window primitive array along the fuselage Z-axis to create two distinct rows. Position the first row at a Y-offset of 0.5 units and the second (upper deck) row at a Y-offset of 1.2 units. For the upper deck row, constrain the X-coordinates to the 'hump' section geometry only. Adjust the spacing parameter between windows from uniform to a variable array that increases by 1.5x in width whenever a door frame primitive is detected on the fuselage surface.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck).

discrepancies.observed: No discernible door geometry or recessed lines on the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular door frames with visible seams.

discrepancies.observed: Windows are only present on the lower main fuselage section.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of windows is located on the upper 'hump' section.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length.
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with larger gaps around door locations and cockpit area.
